starter.alt: The public street-team example opens with Forms inputs, Calculate and a separate Options view awaiting calculation.
starter.caption: Explore example supplies fictional inputs. Set two callouts and calculate to reproduce the five-staff case.

questionOutline.alt: The expanded question breakdown links Options, Next actions, Assumptions, Questions and supporting report questions.
questionOutline.caption: Use the question breakdown to inspect the relevant answer. Navigation performs no calculation or operating action.

financial.alt: Options shows the supported active one-person promotion and its $200 cost and conditional five-guest break-even hurdle; holding remains a separate outside response.
financial.caption: Options focuses on the supported promotion. Other options and holding remain available for inspection; the hurdle does not forecast attendance.

fiveStaff.alt: With five staff available, an active one-person promotion meets the recorded requirements.
fiveStaff.caption: Five available: one active promotion fits. Keeping the team inside is also supported as the outside response.

nextActions.alt: Next actions presents the applicable promotion response and the option to keep the team inside, separately from calculated findings.
nextActions.caption: A supported response is available to inspect. Dispatch and authorization remain outside the calculation.

assumptions.alt: Assumptions states the scope and limits of the promotion calculation, including unknown customer response.
assumptions.caption: Read what the calculation assumes before using its guest hurdle.

questions.alt: The Questions section reports no additional open questions recorded for this case.
questions.caption: An empty recorded-question list does not establish customer response; the calculation’s assumptions and limits still apply.

process.alt: The current promotion process distinguishes active promotion feasibility, the hold-only response and the conditional financial hurdle.
process.caption: Follow the current response paths. Holding the team is separate from finding an active promotion that can operate.

processDetail.alt: Inspecting the active-promotion feasibility question shows the current finding and its supporting response paths.
processDetail.caption: Inspection explains the finding without authorizing a promotion or changing the case.

dependencies.alt: Calculation dependencies shows how the operating assessment supplies the derived guest hurdle.
dependencies.caption: Calculation dependencies describes the flow of findings; it is separate from the business process.

pending.alt: After the third callout is applied, the current finding is stale and requires recalculation.
pending.caption: The changed basis withdraws the earlier answer. Apply a form edit, then recalculate.

fourStaff.alt: At four available staff, no active promotion meets the operating requirements; holding keeps the required four inside.
fourStaff.caption: Four available: active outreach is blocked. Keeping the team inside remains the supported outside response.

thirdCallout.alt: The current Options view distinguishes no active promotion from the supported hold response after the third callout.
thirdCallout.caption: Recalculation withdraws active outreach. A five-guest financial hurdle cannot supply missing floor coverage.

financialReport.alt: Expense recovery inspects the $200 one-person plan at $40 retained contribution: five additional guests cover expense and six exceed it.
financialReport.caption: Supporting reports exposes the conditional guest hurdle and its recorded contribution basis. No attendance forecast is supplied.

comparison.alt: The native financial comparison lists expenses and conditional additional-guest thresholds for the supplied deployments.
comparison.caption: Compare the thresholds while retaining each plan’s separate operating eligibility.

excelCoverage.alt: The current inputs show business-dollar contribution controls with Excel download and upload above the forms.
excelCoverage.caption: Forms and Excel are alternate ways to supply the same case. Business money fields display dollars.
